title: selliguea veitchii
intro: Selliguea veitchii, commonly known as Veitch's Water Clover or Tungang, is a type of plant native to the tropical regions of Southeast Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is often used to treat various health conditions. Selliguea veitchii has been traditionally used to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and loosen mucus. The bioactive constituents of Selliguea veitchii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
